# Master Eldrin Quill

Tall, stooped, ink-stained fingers, beard tied with copper wire. His robe is patched with pages torn from spellbooks.

**Appearance**: 60s, keen blue eyes, carries a crystal shard that hums, smells of ozone and old paper.

**Roleplay**: Absent-minded but sharp, speaks in half-riddles, collects rare components. Will trade spells, identify items, or warn of magical hazards.
**Hook**: Needs wind-walker circle, seeks stolen grimoire, can teleport for a price.
**Stat-ready**: AC 12, HP 38, Spellbook (fireball, shield, dispel magic), Arcane Recovery.
